description: The source traditions use different Hora lordship procedures, which changes the divisional lord assigned to a planet.
why_they_differ: The Brihat Jataka candidate reports a sign-lord/eleventh-house-lord Hora variant; the Phaladeepika passage assigns the two halves to the Sun and Moon with parity reversal. These are not merely translation variants because the owner set and calculation behavior differ.
user_facing_note: Expose the selected Hora convention and do not mix results across it.
